SELECT cc.code_value AS status_code, cc.code_name AS status_name, COUNT(o.inbound_order_id) AS order_count FROM wms.code_group cg JOIN wms.common_code cc ON cc.code_group_id = cg.code_group_id AND cc.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN wms.inbound_order o ON o.status_code = cc.code_value
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms.center_info ci WHERE ci.center_info_id = o.center_info_id AND ci.center_no = #{center_no} )
WHERE cg.group_code = 'INB_STATUS' AND cg.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY cc.code_value, cc.code_name, cc.sort_order ORDER BY cc.sort_order, cc.code_value

SELECT cc.code_value AS status_code, cc.code_name AS status_name, COUNT(o.outbound_order_id) AS order_count FROM wms.code_group cg JOIN wms.common_code cc ON cc.code_group_id = cg.code_group_id AND cc.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN wms.outbound_order o ON o.status_code = cc.code_value
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms.center_info ci WHERE ci.center_info_id = o.center_info_id AND ci.center_no = #{center_no} )
WHERE cg.group_code = 'OUT_STATUS' AND cg.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY cc.code_value, cc.code_name, cc.sort_order ORDER BY cc.sort_order, cc.code_value

SELECT h.order_kind AS order_type, h.order_no, h.from_status_code, h.to_status_code, h.changed_by, h.change_reason, h.changed_at FROM wms.order_status_history h ORDER BY h.changed_at DESC, h.order_status_history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.from_status_code, h.to_status_code, h.changed_by, h.change_reason, h.changed_at FROM wms.order_status_history h WHERE h.order_kind = #{order_type} AND h.order_no = #{order_no} ORDER BY h.changed_at ASC, h.order_status_history_id ASC
